description:
We are the astronauts of the Orion Space Program, dedicated to shaping the next generation of young astronauts. Embarking on an epic journey toward the lunar north pole, we present Mission Supernovaa where you take command of a lunar base and make high-stakes, strategic decisions!

Welcome to Mission Supernovaa, where you are the commander of your own future, and your star will shine like dazzling cosmic curtains!
summary:
Welcome to Mission Supernovaa! For the Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, we didn’t just build a game ,we built a high-stakes lunar survival simulator powered by real NASA open data. As a player, you will take command of Iris Outpost, humanity’s cutting-edge space station on the Moon. Step into the boots of a young mission commander where every choice carries a real engineering cost. Along the way, you will meet and consult expert astronauts who guide you through critical situations. Will you divert precious power to reinforce radiation shielding before a solar storm hits, or keep your lunar greenhouses running to protect your food supply? In Mission Supernovaa, there are no zero-cost decisions, players experience firsthand how oxygen, power, food, and shielding compete for survival. Grounded in real space weather alerts from NASA DONKI and astronaut biological research from OSDR, our game transforms complex mission-planning trade-offs into an interactive, replayable adventure. 
This is real NASA data straight out of reports and into your command console turning space science into an unforgettable lunar adventure!
details:
Supernovaa's Project Solution

Iris: Junior Lunar Mission Trainer is an interactive, high-stakes lunar survival simulation designed to teach players how real engineering trade-offs govern deep-space exploration. By turning complex mission constraints into engaging gameplay, the game empowers players to take command of Iris Outpost on the Moon, making critical, no zero-cost decisions about life support, power, food production, and radiation shielding. Through immersive storytelling and direct guidance from expert astronauts, science is made both fun, accessible, and deeply educational.

How Does Our Solution Work?

In the game, players step into the boots of a lunar commander facing critical survival challenges at the Iris outpost, such as sudden lunar night power loss, solar radiation storms, and carbon dioxide spikes. At the start of each challenge, players discover authentic NASA data and real historical space incidents. Along the way, players team up with specialized mission experts who share their aerospace insights and practical trade-offs, helping them piece together the right scientific solutions to sustain the base and successfully complete their mission,Finally, upon mastering all challenges, players are greeted with an immersive celebration message and an achievement summary card that reviews everything they’ve learned, certifying them as official lunar commanders.

01 · Power Generation, with Lead Power Systems Specialist:

Players meet the Lead Power Systems Specialist to tackle the brutal 14.5-Earth-day lunar night crisis. shows players NASA’s authentic energy simulation data and teaches them core survival strategies. After an interactive trade-off challenge, players evaluate and choose the best plan by weighing power, heat, and fuel costs before locking it in.

02 · Radiation Shielding:

A solar radiation storm is heading straight for the base. Player connects to live NASA data DONKI to track real-time space weather, and reviews historical records from the severe August 1972 solar storm. then learn how passive materials (regolith/water walls) compare to active electromagnetic forcefields. Finally, players evaluate the trade-offs and choose the best shielding system to protect the crew before locking it in.

03 · Life Support :

Carbon dioxide is spiking in Sector B. Players consult the lead bio-systems expert, who uses OSDR data to review how space stations recycle up to 98% of their water. Players learn how to balance air systems by comparing living algae bio-recyclers with high-pressure oxygen purges, then evaluate the trade-offs and choose the best method before locking it in.

04 · Food Production :

The hydroponic dome needs optimization. Players consult the lead botanical expert to review historical space farming milestones—such as astronauts eating red romaine lettuce grown in NASA's Veggie plant box (achieved on August 10, 2015, taking 33 days with wick-based watering). Players learn how to balance crop health by tuning light, nutrient levels, and temperature, then evaluate the trade-offs and lock in their growing plan.

05 · Resource Mining :

The base needs local resources to sustain itself. Players consult the lead excavation expert to review authentic mission data—such as NASA's LCROSS mission impacting the Moon's Cabeus crater on October 9, 2009, confirming the discovery of water ice crystals on November 13. Players learn how to operate lunar excavators to dig up regolith and water ice, then evaluate the trade-offs of using off-world resources instead of carrying everything from Earth before locking in their extraction plan.

When the player finishes the mission, a celebratory message will appear announcing that they have completed the Supernova mission, along with a card summarizing everything they've learned!

Supernovaa benefits & Impact:

  • Gamified Science: Simplifies complex aerospace and lunar concepts into fun, accessible interactive adventures that make science engaging for everyone.
  • Democratizing Space Data: Bridges the gap between raw NASA scientific archives. Real-World Relevance: Mirrors the operational logic used by mission planners for Artemis lunar architecture.
  • Mindset Shift: Shifts students from consumers of facts to active engineering decision-makers. Literacy through Play: Demystifies high-level aerospace concepts through accessible gameplay.
  • Inspirational & Social Impact: Anchored in Human Stories: Features a narrative arc inspired by the dream of joining NASA's Orion program, connecting emotional aspiration with scientific rigor.

Our goal:

Taking It Global, Inspiring Future Astronauts:

Our goal is to scale Supernovaa to an international level, bridging the gap between NASA's open data and young minds worldwide. We aim to reach every child who dreams of becoming an astronaut—giving them the unique chance to step into the boots of a lunar commander, interact with expert astronauts, and experience the thrill of space exploration firsthand. By turning complex aerospace concepts into an engaging browser-based adventure, we are empowering the next generation of global innovators, scientists, and space explorers.

Creative Elements

  • Narrative-Driven Lunar Command (Orion Journey): The core gameplay is anchored in an immersive storytelling arc inspired by the dream of joining NASA's Orion program, where players are selected to step into the boots of a lunar commander and lead the survival of the outpost.
  • Cinematic Tech-Gen Art & Gamified Mechanics: Features an eye-catching, cinematic visual style tailored for the tech-savvy digital generation, transforming complex aerospace concepts into an engaging interactive browser adventure.

Technologies & Deployment:

  • HTML5 & CSS3: Used for structuring the user interface, styling the dashboard, and building the web components.
  • JavaScript (with Phaser): Powers the core 2D game development, interactive lunar outpost mechanics, and smooth browser-based gameplay.
  • Vercel: Used for high-performance deployment, hosting, and seamless live-sharing of the web application.
